t2i_prompt: A 1440 px wide desktop website section as a flat straight-on UI mockup over a full-bleed photographic macro: a pale polypropylene butt-fusion bead sweeping diagonally, duotone deep navy and limestone, shallow depth of field, navy shadows in the corners. Top-left: a small uppercase eyebrow and a large light-weight sans headline. Over the bead, its contour traced in a crisp steel-blue hairline with numbered dot-terminated leader lines. On the right, a hairline table with mono-numbered rows overlaid on the photo for <CONTENT>. Square corners, no cards, no shadows.
signature_idea: The weld itself becomes the diagram: its contour traced and numbered over a duotone macro, each number a row in the standard table beside it.
strengths: shows the real material story (PP fusion) up close
duotone keeps the photo inside the navy/limestone palette
traced contour plus numbers is a distinctive, ownable device
light headline and mono numbers are on-brand
table reads cleanly on the dark area
weaknesses: callout numbers duplicated (01 and 02 appear twice) and do not map clearly
traced contour does not match the bead shape
table text over the bright highlight loses contrast
photo subject is ambiguous, could be any pipe
brand_fit_why: Duotone navy/limestone, steel-blue hairlines, light headline and mono numbers fit; muddled callouts and a busy photo behind the table cost calm and precision.
